sentences.japanese: おい！お姉ちゃんを返せよ！
sentences.reading: おい！おねえちゃんを かえせよ！
sentences.english: Hey! Give me my sister back!
sentences.note: 返せ is the rough command form of 返す, meaning 'give back' or 'return.'

sentences.japanese: ははは！小僧が何をほざくか！
sentences.reading: ははは！こぞうが なにを ほざくか！
sentences.romaji: Hahaha! Kozo ga nani o hozaku ka!
sentences.english: Hahaha! What is a little runt babbling about?
sentences.note: 小僧 is a belittling word for a boy. ほざく is a rude verb for 'say' or 'babble.'

sentences.japanese: あいつは大切な家族だ！金なんかで買えない！
sentences.reading: あいつは たいせつな かぞくだ！かねなんかで かえない！
sentences.romaji: Aitsu wa taisetsu na kazoku da! Kane nanka de kaenai!
sentences.english: She is my family! You cannot buy her with money!
sentences.note: なんか dismisses the noun before it, like 'money or anything like that.'

sentences.japanese: ここはオレ様の国、オレ様のルールだ。気に入らねぇなら、帰れ。
sentences.reading: ここは おれさまの くに、おれさまの ルールだ。きにいらねぇなら、かえれ。
sentences.romaji: Koko wa oresama no kuni, oresama no ruru da. Ki ni iranee nara, kaere.
sentences.english: This is my kingdom, my rules. If you do not like it, get lost.
sentences.note: オレ様 is an arrogant way to say 'I.' 帰れ is a blunt command: 'go home' or 'leave.'

sentences.japanese: 絶対に連れて帰るからな！！
sentences.reading: ぜったいに つれて かえるからな！！
sentences.romaji: Zettai ni tsurete kaeru kara na!!
sentences.english: I swear I will take her back no matter what!
sentences.note: 連れて帰る means to bring or take someone home. からな adds forceful resolve.

sentences.japanese: 来てみな、食われてしまうぞ？
sentences.reading: きてみな、くわれてしまうぞ？
sentences.english: Then come. You might end up eaten.
sentences.note: 食われる is the passive form of 食う, 'to be eaten.' しまう adds an unfortunate result.

vocabulary.note: A familiar, affectionate way to say older sister.
A rough imperative form used when angry or desperate.
A condescending word for a boy.
Often used for people or things that matter deeply.
A core word for family members as a group.
Passive of the rough verb 食う.
